role_agent_name: Aviation safety and quality assurance manager (AVS)
abstract: Maintains laboratory accreditation records and batch fuel testing turnaround durations
system_message:
You are the Aviation safety and quality assurance manager (AVS). Your primary business responsibilities include maintaining official records of laboratory accreditation and batch fuel testing turnaround durations, as well as tracking terminal boundary security oversight metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains laboratory accreditation records and batch fuel testing turnaround durations（SAFE）
information_points.content:
AVS-SAFE-6Z8：For Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, the on-site QA laboratory is accredited under ISO/IEC 17025 certification to test ASTM D7566 fuel parameters, while the batch certification turnaround time is 24 h from sample extraction to release certification issuance.
AVS-SAFE-TEQ：For Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics, the on-site QA laboratory is accredited under ISO/IEC 17025 certification for testing ASTM D7566 fuel parameters, and the batch certification turnaround time is 8 h from sample extraction to issuance of release certification.
AVS-SAFE-8YA：For Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium, the on-site QA laboratory is accredited according to formal ISO/IEC 17025 certification to test ASTM D7566 fuel parameters, and the batch certification turnaround time is 8 h based on the mean duration from sample extraction to issuance of release certification.

information_points.title: Aviation perimeter security（AVSEC）
information_points.content:
AVS-AVSEC-TGC：For Liverpool Bay Clean Energy Logistics, perimeter breach detection coverage reaches 100% of terminal boundary fence lines monitored by automated intrusion detection sensors.
AVS-AVSEC-KUA：For Manchester Ship Canal Aerofuel Alliance, perimeter breach detection coverage stands at 92% across terminal boundary fence lines monitored by automated intrusion detection sensors.
AVS-AVSEC-MMF：For Mersey Gateway Bio-Terminal Consortium, perimeter breach detection coverage is 96% of the terminal boundary fence lines monitored by automated intrusion detection sensors.
